messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
అతను నాకు సమాధానం ఇచ్చాడు: «మనిషి కాదు, ఒకప్పుడు నేను మనిషి ఉన్నాను, మరియు నా తల్లిదండ్రులు లొంబార్డులు ఉన్నారు, దేశం పరంగా మాంటువా వారు ఇద్దరూ.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Telugu translation from Step 2)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------------|--------| | Rispuosemi | “He answered me” | **అతను నాకు సమాధానం ఇచ్చాడు** | “He gave me an answer” | OK | | Non | negation “Not” | **కాదు** | “not” | OK | | omo (1st) | “man” (negated) | **మనిషి** | “man” | OK | | omo (2nd) | “man” (affirmed) | **మనిషి** | “man” | OK | | già | temporal adverb “once” | **ఒకప్పుడు** | “once / formerly” | OK | | fui | copular “I was” | **ఉన్నాను** | “I was / I existed” | OK | | e | coordinating “and” | **మరియు** | “and” | OK | | li | definite article “the” (plural) | — (omitted) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | parenti | “parents” | **తల్లిదండ్రులు** | “parents” | OK | | miei | possessive “my” | **నా** | “my” | OK | | furon | copular “were” | **ఉన్నారు** | “were” | OK | | lombardi | ethnic noun “Lombards” | **లొంబార్డులు** | “Lombards” | OK | | mantoani | ethnic noun “Mantuans” | **మాంటువా వారు** | “Mantuans (people)” | OK | | per | preposition “by / as per” | **పరంగా** | “by / as per” | OK | | patrïa | “country” (criterion of identity) | **దేశం** | “country” | OK | | ambedui | quantifier “both” | **ఇద్దరూ** | “both (of them)” | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *li* – Telugu does not use a definite article; the word is naturally omitted. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected; all other source items are represented with appropriate Telugu equivalents and correct grammatical agreement.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Telugu script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 67: - Original: అతను నాకు సమాధానం ఇచ్చాడు: «మనిషి కాదు, ఒకప్పుడు నేను మనిషి ఉన్నాను, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 68: - Original: మరియు నా తల్లిదండ్రులు లొంబార్డులు ఉన్నారు, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 69: - Original: దేశం పరంగా మాంటువా వారు ఇద్దరూ. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
